Pfizer's net margin in fiscal Q3 2024 (three months ended September 29, 2024) is net income attributable to Pfizer divided by total revenues.

- Net income attributable to Pfizer common shareholders: $4,465 million
- Total revenues: $17,702 million

Net margin = 4,465 / 17,702 = 25.22%

If the margin used net income before allocation to noncontrolling interests ($4,473 million), it would be 25.27%, a negligible difference. I used the figure attributable to Pfizer shareholders.
